title: A Detailed Study on LLM Biases Concerning Corporate Social Responsibility and Green Supply Chains

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Perceived Role of Ethics and Social Responsibility (PRESOR) psychometric questionnaire to LLMs via standardized Likert-scale prompts to measure their ideological preferences regarding profitability, social responsibility, and shareholder primacy vs. stakeholder capitalism. This was tested both under default settings and by prompting the models to adopt specific organizational culture personas.

Administering the Green Supply Chain Partnerships (GSCP) scale to LLMs using standardized Likert-scale prompts to evaluate their propensity for and prioritization of environmental collaboration with suppliers and customers, both with and without organizational culture role-playing prompts.

primary_bias_target: Sustainability and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Bias
